releaseNotes: v1.5.47: Real-time dynamic pass validity & status visibility (Active, Grace, Expired, Suspended) across digital ID card, student dashboard, and admin check-in scanner with 1-tap instant renewal payment action.

organization.name: The Cozy Corner Centre
organization.address: Front Of Reliance Fashion Factory, Nath Road, Parli-431515

studentFeatures.title: Real-Time Pass Validity & Dynamic Status
studentFeatures.description: Your digital student pass automatically updates to Active, Grace Period, or Expired based on your plan end date, with instant 1-tap renewal to retain your study seat.

studentFeatures.title: Dynamic Seat Radar Card Status
studentFeatures.description: Your allocated desk card alerts you with clear guidance when your membership is in grace or expired, with direct action to renew.

studentFeatures.title: Larger QR Code & Instant Tap-to-Zoom
studentFeatures.description: Your pass QR code is now bigger, sharper, and can be tapped to open a full-screen high-contrast view for easy desk scanning.

studentFeatures.title: Pinned Edit Profile Dialog & Photo Upload
studentFeatures.description: The Edit Profile dialog now pins the Submit button cleanly above your keyboard and navigation bar. Updating your profile photo is instant and error-free.

studentFeatures.title: Instant Notifications & Seat Requests
studentFeatures.description: The Notifications Center and Seat Change request features now load seamlessly without any permission or access blocks.

adminFeatures.title: Dynamic Student Validity & Expiration Engine
adminFeatures.description: Student membership evaluation runs dynamically in real time. Expired passes are automatically flagged with instant check-in verification.

adminFeatures.title: Instant QR Scan Expiration & 1-Tap Payment
adminFeatures.description: Scanning a student QR instantly displays valid, grace, or expired states with instant action to record renewal payments directly from the check-in sheet.

adminFeatures.title: Hardened Firestore Rules & Dynamic Attribution
adminFeatures.description: Fine-grained Firestore Security Rules allow student photo updates, seat changes, and personal notifications while maintaining strict zero-trust isolation.
